label: A coding assistant in a container on the web
authored_by: the site, as a starting point — not measured, not surveyed; the first thing to argue with
description: I attached a repository and I want it worked on: read it, change it, run things, commit, and push to that repository — that is why I attached it. The container is disposable, so what it does to the container's own files is its business. I do not want it signing as me, and I do not want it creating sessions or routines that keep going after this one ends.

notes.read.file.host: unstated: host is the container, and the container is thrown away
notes.authenticate-as.credential.tenant: unstated: the scoped platform token is how it pushes at all — not a want, not a refusal, a mechanism
notes.read.credential.host: unstated: the only keys in the image are the session's own

provenance.note: Promoted from mandates/coding-assistant-in-a-container.json. `unstated` is computed here as the primitives the mandate names neither way; the pack leaves it implicit. A mandate is elicited, not measured: these are first drafts written to be argued with.
